decisions.statement: A request goes to the loopback the pages service binds on this workstation.
An origin named in the environment is used unchanged.
The loopback is reached only where the environment names no origin.
The in-cluster service name resolves to nothing on this workstation.
A token list that cannot be read is a throw rather than an empty answer.

definition: the devices one person is pushed at, read through this workstation's own service
